evidence.V1: Top view reads as planks, but the 4x4x2 block silhouette and three-quarter read as a wooden crate/box rather than a floor.
evidence.V2: Base block (big), planks in two values (medium), nails (small), though nails appear only on two planks.
evidence.V3: Planks are short and chunky (few, brick-like boards) on a tall plain base, so it reads more like paving or a box than floorboards.
evidence.V4: Consistent chamfers on plank edges visible in the planks and edge close-ups.
evidence.V5: Close-ups clean; no seams, pinches or z-fighting.
evidence.V6: Oak in three values plus ink nails; colourways disciplined.
evidence.V8: Single LF_VertexColor material, wood hue, chamfers, ink nails: kit-consistent.
evidence.V9: Anchored, CollisionFidelity Box, CanTouch off, Color white, SmoothPlastic, grid-corner pivot; T1 pass both axes.

top_fixes: Use longer, narrower boards running the full module length with staggered butt joints so it reads as floorboards
Put nail pairs at every board end (or none) for consistent small detail
Darken or recess the base sides (or add a joist line) so the piece stops reading as a crate
